The strongest enterprise and mid-market marketing doesn't lead with a product — it leads with the problem a buyer already has. A hospital administrator isn't looking for "Lyft Concierge"; they're looking to reduce missed appointments. An auto dealer principal isn't looking for a rideshare product; they're looking to keep loaner logistics from costing them revenue.
We are in the process of revising our go-to-market for Lyft Business to organize around these audiences and their transportation problems, with Concierge, Lyft Pass, Business Profiles, and our Business Travel products positioned as the answer to a clearly named pain point by customer profile.
We're hiring an Industry Marketing Manager to build that audience-first structure for our priority verticals, starting with Healthcare and Automotive , across both mid-market and enterprise segments. You'll own the vertical narrative and the content, demand generation strategy, and enablement that will drive marketing-attributable revenue.
The primary function of this role is to build and lead vertical-specific go-to-market (GTM) motions for our mid-market and Enterprise business — bringing together vertical-specific content, demand generation, and sales enablement into a coherent, audience-first strategy.

Own vertical strategy and integrated programs
Design and execute large, orchestrated tentpole programs for our priority verticals (no more than 2 per quarter) — multichannel activation spanning digital, live events, paid media, social, and press — that bring our value proposition and industry point of view to life for a defined buyer (e.g., hospital CFO, healthcare operations leader, dealer principal/service manager).
Build and maintain a thought leadership agenda for each prioritized vertical: original research, proof points, and points of view that establish Lyft as the transportation authority in that space.
Lead Healthcare as the highest-revenue priority, and scale the model to new verticals
Own the strategic objective for Healthcare: defend Lyft's market leadership in NEMT (Non-Emergency Medical Transportation) while identifying and building new growth avenues within the segment.
Treat Healthcare as the proof-of-concept for vertical GTM — once the content, demand gen, and enablement model is working there, codify what worked into a repeatable playbook.
Scale that playbook to other priority verticals (e.g., Automotive, Universities, Hospitality/Events) as "Scalable Growth" opportunities — each with its own buyer, core transportation problem, and proof points, but built on a shared, repeatable "ROI playbook" methodology (defined vertical narrative → targeted demand gen → sales enablement → measured pipeline impact).
Drive cross-functional alignment and partnership
Build a strong, trust-based partnership with Sales and Product leadership; represent vertical marketing's point of view in cross-functional and executive forums.
Produce vertical-specific content and proof points that support Sales conversations and strengthen our positioning with target buyers.
Partner with Sales on account-based marketing (ABM) for priority accounts, and support full-funnel marketing ownership: from vertical paid demand generation and lead qualification (MQL/SQL definitions) through to sales handoff.
Bring together marketing, sales, and product perspectives across mid-market and enterprise segments. This role is the connective force that pulls a multi-faceted go-to-market motion into a coherent, audience-first strategy.
Scale through agencies and partners
Manage relationships with marketing and creative agencies to scale program execution, from campaign development through multichannel activation.
Build and run co-marketing programs with industry and technology partners to extend reach and credibility within each vertical.
Ensure all vertical marketing programs comply with the relevant regulatory and marketing requirements of the industry (e.g., healthcare marketing/compliance considerations).
Measure and prioritize with data
Define success metrics for every program and report business impact against them: pipeline influenced, MQL/SQL conversion, program ROI.
Bring rigor and evidence-based prioritization to a growing portfolio of vertical initiatives, using internal analytics tools to establish accurate baselines and guide where to invest next.

Wir möchten sicherstellen, dass Du perfekt zu uns passt und wir zu Dir! Deshalb haben wir einen transparenten und fairen Bewerbungsprozess, der uns die Möglichkeit gibt, Dich besser kennenzulernen und Dir gleichzeitig einen guten Einblick in unsere Arbeitsweise zu geben. Hier sind die einzelnen Schritte:
Schick uns Deine Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf, kleinem Motivationsschreiben und Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).
Wir prüfen Deine Bewerbung und bewerten, ob Deine Erfahrungen und Fähigkeiten zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Wir melden uns in der Regel innerhalb von maximal 3 Werktagen bei Dir.
Wenn uns Deine Bewerbung überzeugt, laden wir Dich zu einem ca. 30-minütigen Video-Call ein. Ziel ist es, Dich persönlich kennenzulernen, mehr über Deine Motivation zu erfahren und Dir gleichzeitig mehr über uns, unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise zu erzählen.
Um Dein Können besser einschätzen zu können, bitten wir Dich ggf. im Anschluss nach dem Call noch um eine kurze Testaufgabe. Diese Aufgabe simuliert typische Projekte aus unserem Arbeitsalltag. Du hast genug Zeit, sie in Ruhe in den nächsten Tagen zu bearbeiten.
In einem zweiten Gespräch besprechen wir die Ergebnisse der Testaufgabe, klären offene Fragen und vertiefen bestimmte Themen – seien es Fragen zu Deiner Arbeitsweise, Deine Wünsche an uns oder unsere Erwartungen an Dich.
Wenn beide Seiten ein gutes Gefühl haben, senden wir Dir ein verbindliches Angebot zu. Sobald Du zustimmst, starten wir gemeinsam durch!
Hast Du noch Fragen? Wir stehen Dir gerne zur Verfügung. Schreib uns einfach an.
Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen und gemeinsam mit Dir die Zukunft des E-Mail- und WhatsApp-Marketings zu gestalten!

We're looking for a Staff Product Marketing Manager to join our PMM team during a pivotal period of growth.

This is a high-ownership role at the center of everything Cockroach Labs does: you'll own the go-to-market for a defined portfolio of product areas, serve as the go-to-market lead for our company rebrand — the biggest brand moment in our history — and act as a launch bench across one of the densest release calendars we've ever shipped, including major GA milestones across editions, deployment, and operations.
Your product portfolio anchors one of our most strategic stories — how CockroachDB runs, watches, and connects itself in production: Observability & AI-Assisted Insights (including our new autonomous monitoring agent), Workload Management , and Ecosystem & Platform Integration (change data capture and how CockroachDB plugs into the modern data stack).

Together these areas sit at the heart of CockroachDB's AI-operations narrative and its “fits your stack” story, and you'll shape how the market understands them.
Product Marketing at Cockroach Labs sits inside the Product organization within R&D, which means you're embedded in the product development lifecycle from the start: you'll attend product planning, know the roadmap two quarters out, and author the “so what” for every feature that ships in your areas. If you like working with R&D in the morning, Demand Generation mid-day, and Sales in the afternoon, we'd love to hear from you.
You Will Own
Positioning and messaging for your portfolio. Develop, test, and deliver compelling positioning and value propositions for your product areas, tuned to the needs of key personas — developers, platform engineers, architects, and enterprise buyers. The core skill of this role is translation: taking complex technical capabilities and expressing them in language a CIO acts on.
Rebrand go-to-market. Lead the cross-functional go-to-market program for the company rebrand: narrative, messaging migration, launch sequencing, field and customer communications, and enablement — coordinating across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Comms to land it on time and with impact.
Product launches and releases. Drive launch-grade execution for the releases in your areas and serve as a shared launch bench for marquee GA moments across the roadmap. Help install and run a standardized launch playbook used for every product release.
Content and bill of materials. Create high-impact collateral — product briefs, website copy, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, and sales assets — that communicates real customer value, not feature lists.
Sales enablement. Build training and enablement that Sales actually uses: where we win by vertical, use case, and persona; how to tell the cost and resilience story against Aurora, Oracle, and Spanner; and how to sell in business language rather than database terms.
Market and competitive intelligence. Analyze industry trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape. Feed win/loss insight, product analytics, and field feedback back into positioning, roadmap conversations, and enablement priorities.
Cross-functional GTM collaboration. Operate as a trusted partner to Product Management, Education, Demand Generation, and Sales. Influence outcomes across teams you don't own, and build joint deliverables that make the whole go-to-market stronger.
The Expectations
In your first 30 days, you'll go deep on the product (create clusters, run workloads), your journeys, and our go-to-market strategy. You'll build relationships with the PMs and engineering leaders behind your areas, audit the existing positioning and content, and get hands-on with the rebrand program plan.
By 60 days, you'll have refined messaging for your portfolio, taken ownership of the rebrand go-to-market workstream, and built the launch plan for the next release cycle in your areas. You'll complete 200-level Cockroach University courses.
By 90 days, you'll be executing in full: launches shipping on your playbook, rebrand milestones on track, enablement delivered to Sales, and an operating rhythm established with Product, Demand Generation, Content, and AR/PR.
You Have
8+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years in enterprise software/SaaS product marketing with a proven record of launching products to market (we're hiring at the Senior or Staff level depending on experience)
Enterprise infrastructure or developer-tools experience: you've marketed deeply technical products to developers, architects, and CTOs/CIOs, and you hold your own in the room with technical buyers — ideally with exposure to the database, data infrastructure, or AI categories
Exceptional technical-to-business translation ability: you instinctively rewrite “geo-partitioned leaseholder rebalancing” as “your app is fast everywhere your customers are”
Launch leadership: you've run complex, cross-functional launches end to end — and ideally a rebrand, repositioning, or category-level messaging change
Strong writing chops: you produce unique, personable long-form content that technical audiences actually want to read
Analytical rigor: you use win/loss analysis, product analytics, and pipeline data to inform strategy, prove what's working, and kill what isn't
The ability to thoughtfully use LLMs to radically improve PMM effectiveness
A track record of operating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales as a trusted advisor — navigating ambiguity, integrating diverse perspectives, and driving measurable results without direct ownership of every outcome

Experience marketing against cloud-native default databases (Aurora, DynamoDB, Spanner) and overcoming “good enough + already on AWS” inertia
Experience positioning observability, AIOps, or AI-assisted products
Familiarity with data integration and streaming ecosystems (change data capture, Kafka, schema registries) and how enterprises evaluate “fits my stack”
Experience building or running competitive intelligence programs (battlecards, win/loss cadences, sales feedback loops)

Braze is looking for an experienced product marketer to own the go-to-market strategy and positioning for our orchestration products. In this role, you will work to deeply understand the relevant personas, craft differentiated positioning and messaging, bring new products and features to market, serve as the resident GTM expert for your product area, amplify our story through marketing campaigns and collateral, and enable GTM teams.

Develop a strong understanding of our core buyer personas and end users

Prepare highly compelling content and collateral (e.g. web pages, demo videos, sales decks, webinars, blogs, customer stories)
Independently lead product launches and releases for new products, features, and enhancements
Serve as a subject matter expert who can comfortably deliver thought leadership, use case walkthroughs, demos, and product roadmap presentations to internal and external audiences
Drive continued product adoption through impactful programs that inspire & educate our customers on the wide range of use cases they can accomplish
Partner with enablement teams to ensure that the entire GTM function has the appropriate training and tools required to successfully speak to our capabilities

6+ years of product or solutions marketing experience, preferably at high-growth B2B SaaS companies

Proven track record working collaboratively to take new products and features to the market and drive their continued success

Metrics-driven and focused on driving incremental results
Natural curiosity and empathy for customers and their challenges

Experience in B2B marketing, with exposure to both enterprise and SMB businesses
Experience marketing products that sit at the intersection of data, AI, and customer experience
Familiarity with journey orchestration tools, decisioning engines, or AI-assisted marketing platforms

Healthcare should work for patients, but it doesn’t. In their time of need, they call down outdated insurance directories. Then wait on hold. Then wait weeks for the privilege of a visit. Then wait in a room solely designed for waiting. Then wait for a surprise bill. In any other consumer industry, the companies delivering such a poor customer experience would not survive. But in healthcare, patients lack market power. Which means they are expected to accept the unacceptable.
Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. To do that, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace that makes it easy to find and book in-person or virtual care in all 50 states, across +200 specialties and +12k insurance plans. By giving patients the ability to see and choose, we give them power.

In doing so, we can make healthcare work like every other consumer sector, where businesses compete for customers, not the other way around. In time, this will drive quality up and prices down.
We’re 18 years old and the leader in our space, but we are still just getting started. If you like solving important, complex problems alongside deeply thoughtful, driven, and collaborative teammates, read on.

Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people. As a CRM Marketing Manager you’ll play a meaningful role in making sure we build interesting and effective campaigns that engage patients and ultimately drive sessions and rebookings. The role will play an integral part in driving revenue and patient loyalty via CRM channels. If you’re ready to help us transform healthcare, we want to hear from you!
You’ll enjoy this role if you…
Have a passion for technology and improving patients’ lives
Enjoy using data and analytics
Are a strategic thinker who can seamlessly shift between high-level planning and hands-on execution
Highly organized, impeccable attention to detail, and great at prioritizing what needs to get done now, and what should wait until later
Love ideating, executing, and testing new ideas
Are action-oriented; you understand that ideas are easy, but implementation is where the magic is
Work well in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and are able to manage competing priorities

Owning end-to-end campaign development process, including list/segment creation, test setup, email development, QA, deployment and analysis
Developing, planning, executing, and optimizing CRM campaigns through rigorous, hypothesis-driven A/B or multivariate testing, using email, SMS, push notifications, and in app messages to meet business goals
Brainstorming new campaign ideas and collaborating with cross-functional teams like Engineering, Product Marketing, Product, Analytics, Design, and Brand to execute marketing campaigns and support cross-functional initiatives with no supervision
Monitoring deliverability and maintain email health metrics to determine optimal frequency and form of communications
Owning CRM metrics for sends, opens, clicks, and downstream metrics like sessions, app downloads, and bookings for campaigns and ensure send triggers and messages are functioning properly
Driving engagement booking targets
You’ll be successful in this role if you have…
7+ years of work experience in a highly analytical CRM role
Proven track record of ideating and executing highly impactful CRM marketing campaigns to drive business objectives
Strong analytical skills (particularly within Excel and Looker) and the ability to leverage data for insights and action.
Deep Braze knowledge - you are a Braze power user and adept at HTML
Incredible attention to detail especially when it comes to campaign QA
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 11 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day.

We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful.

We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World.
As the Influencer Marketing Coordinator, you will help support influencer community building and day-to-day talent/campaign management at Glossier. You will be joining a small, dedicated team that executes all influencer partnerships and affiliate program initiatives.

We are looking for someone who is extremely passionate about identifying and building meaningful relationships to help grow Glossier’s brand reach through people-powered storytelling.

In this role, you will bring a challenger mindset—finding creative ways to grow Glossier’s share of voice across social media in a way that aligns with our values, positioning, and objectives. You will ensure that equity and a people-first lens are at the forefront of your work.
This role will sit within the Marketing team and report to the Influencer Marketing Associate Manager.

Scouting and discovery of both LA-local and global influencer talent that strategically aligns with brand and campaign goals
Coordinate offer letters and contracts between agents, talent, and Glossier’s legal counsel
Manage affiliate program communications, including direct email inquiries, affiliate program content, invitations, and gifting through ShopMy
Maintain master influencer database, product seeding tracker, and other internal influencer team documents
Organize and manage beauty closet, replenishing product quantities, ordering new samples, overseeing product send-outs/mailers, and entertaining VIP guests coming in to shop.
Manage reporting inclusive of post-performance campaign insights, mailer/ugc tracking, and ad-hoc internal presentations
Partner with the paid media team to identify trending UGC content and oversee communication and outreach to UGC creators
Handle administrative tasks, including new vendor forms, talent PO’s, and invoices, coordinating with internal finance team to ensure all documents are submitted and invoices paid on time
Twelve Month Expectations
Own relationships with LA-local influencers, and create an unparalleled experience for influencers that fuels excitement & engagement and sustains brand love
Proactively pitches partnership and plus-up opportunities that feel like a right brand fit and further storytell within campaign moments
Increase share of voice across IG and TikTok through ongoing relationship building and product seeding
Build a consistent ecosystem through our LA showroom, fostering relationships with the in-store editor team and VIPs visiting
Audit existing talent directory to identify areas of opportunity for gifting and paid partnerships that align with the marketing calendar and planned activations
Monitor influencer industry trends and new platform updates, finding ways to integrate learnings into existing influencer strategy
Partner cross-functionally, finding creative ways to leverage influencer partners across campaign & brand moments

1-3 years experience working in an influencer marketing, affiliate, or similar role that is grounded in relationship management and community
Previous experience working within a beauty or lifestyle brand and/or agency is preferred
Passionate about creating best-in-class experiences for both influencer partners & our customers
Strong external and internal communication skills
Solid visual and verbal presentation skills
Exceptional relationship management skills
Connected to culture and has finger on the pulse of all things influencer industry
Must be LA-based and able to be in office 3x a week

As the Product Marketing Manager for Privacy and Video Security, you will play a dual role sitting at the intersection of Verkada’s core corporate mission and our flagship product.
First, you will be responsible for defining and driving the narrative around Verkada’s approach to privacy and data security.

These elements are never afterthoughts at Verkada; they are foundational to how we design our technology and a core differentiator that enables us to earn the trust of – and successfully sell to – some of the world’s largest organizations.

In this role, you will lead the charge in proactively establishing Verkada as the undisputed leader in how a cloud-first physical security company should approach privacy and data security.

You will go incredibly deep into the weeds of our technical architecture, becoming a subject matter expert who can be strategically deployed to create customer-facing collateral, go toe-to-toe with technical experts and executive buyers, and evangelize our privacy and security posture across the entire go-to-market engine.
Second, you will play a critical role in driving the growth of Verkada’s largest product line, Video Security. Working alongside our existing Video Security PMM team, you will co-own the go-to-market strategy and oversee high-profile product launches. Beyond leading launches, you will be integral in translating hardware and software features into the collateral needed to enable our Sales, Demand Generation, and Channel Marketing teams to win.
Both halves of this role are deeply cross-functional and require you to bring together stakeholders across the Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Communications teams. You will also partner closely with Verkada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and Chief Privacy Officer.
We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This position will be based in-person at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

Hone Verkada’s privacy and security narrative: Clearly articulate how Verkada differentiates itself, our fundamental approach to data protection, and how these practices deliver value to our customers. Refine and adapt our messaging and positioning strategies in response to product developments, competitor movements, and public sentiment.
Drive proactive privacy thought leadership and asset creation: Author, advise on, and elevate high-impact collateral – including technical whitepapers, one-pagers, blogs, videos, and sales decks – to position Verkada as the definitive authority in the space. Take complete ownership of the Verkada Trust Hub webpage, significantly expanding its depth to turn it into a comprehensive, best-in-class destination for public transparency.
Execute Video Security product launches: Bring new Video Security products and features to market by developing competitively differentiated messaging and positioning, setting a go-to-market plan, and planning and creating deliverables in order to maximize impact.
Serve as a cross-functional subject matter expert: Act as a definitive expert on both Video Security and data privacy across our product portfolio. Unite Marketing, Sales, and Product teams to drive commercial results, lead Executive Briefing Center (EBC) sessions, and directly empower our field organization to navigate complex technical privacy evaluations.
Enable the go-to-market engine: Partner closely with Sales, Demand Generation, Creative, and Channel Marketing teams to accelerate pipeline growth. Translate complex hardware capabilities and technical privacy frameworks into high-impact outbound marketing assets and field collateral that directly improve win rates.

2-4+ years of product marketing or related experience in B2B SaaS or IoT
Exceptional writing skills with meticulous attention to detail and ability to write content for a variety of audiences, including highly technical content
Extreme curiosity and desire to dive deep into the weeds of all things privacy and enterprise data security. Self-directed and able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

Fin is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to own and scale our portfolio of curated and third-party programs in EMEA. This role is critical to building meaningful, high-impact touchpoints with prospects and customers, turning regional experiences into measurable pipeline and revenue.

· Develop account-focused programs: Collaborate with GTM teams to support account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives through curated experiences

· Own performance measurement: Track results and report on pipeline, influence, and revenue impact

· Build scalable processes: Create repeatable frameworks and playbooks for regional event execution and optimization

· Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with Brand, Growth, Product Marketing, and Customer teams to ensure consistent messaging and strong execution

· Proven track record of driving pipeline generation and influencing revenue through events and field programs

· Experience executing both curated (owned) and third-party (sponsored) events

· Strong understanding of how to engage accounts across the funnel, from early-stage awareness to late-stage deal acceleration

· Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering closely with Sales and cross-functional teams

· Strategic mindset with the ability to connect program execution to broader business goals

· Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously

· Data-driven approach to measurement, reporting, and optimization

· Experience with ABM strategies and targeting is a plus

· Willingness to travel to support key regional events

· Regional event programs consistently generate high-quality pipeline and influence revenue

· Strong alignment and trust with Sales and GTM partners

· Events are thoughtfully designed, well-executed, and highly engaging for target audiences

· Clear visibility into performance, with measurable impact on pipeline creation and deal acceleration

Reporting into the VP of brand and communications, you’ll drive ownership of the WRITER brand, internal and external, from campaign strategy to the systems that make great brand work scalable. You’ll help shape how the world sees us, how our employees feel about us, how our product expresses us, and how AI makes all of that more powerful.

If you’re a brand leader who thinks in systems, ships with taste, and is genuinely excited about what agentic AI makes possible for marketing, this is your role.

Brand strategy and campaigns - You’ll lead brand campaign strategy from idea through activation — not just the brief, but the conviction behind it. You’ll develop concepts worth executing, manage the work end-to-end, and hold the bar for what “on-brand” actually means.

You’ll ensure every campaign builds something cumulative: a brand that people recognize, trust, and root for. You’ll partner closely with product marketing on integrated go-to-market campaigns, ensuring brand and demand work in lockstep.
The full customer and employee journey - Great brands don’t live in one channel. You’ll activate WRITER’s brand across the customer journey, and bring the same intentionality to the employee experience. Onboarding, all-hands, internal comms: the brand lives there too, and you’ll make sure it shows up with the same quality and care.
AI-native brand operations - WRITER brings the power of agentic marketing to the world’s best brands — and we run on our own platform.

You’ll own WRITER’s internal WRITER instance as the operational backbone of our brand: encoding our voice, guidelines, and creative standards into brand skills that the entire company relies on to produce high-quality, on-brand work at scale.

You’ll build and maintain the skill library that makes WRITER employees faster, sharper, and more consistent — without losing what makes us distinctively us. You’ll partner with product and engineering to translate that front-line experience into product insights, acting as an in-house advisor to make WRITER stronger for brand leaders everywhere.
Brand in the product - WRITER’s biggest brand touchpoint is the product itself. You’ll work with product and design to ensure our brand identity is felt inside the platform: in the copy, the experience, the moments that tell customers they’re working with something built with genuine craft and conviction.
Agency management - You’ll be WRITER’s day-to-day lead for our brand agency — setting the brief, driving the relationship, and making sure partners deliver work that actually moves us forward, giving them a clear point of view to work from.
Measurement and brand intelligence - What doesn’t get measured doesn’t get protected. You’ll define and own the metrics that matter — brand awareness, perception, campaign performance, pipeline influence — and use those signals to continuously sharpen strategy. You’ll conduct ongoing competitive and market research to keep WRITER’s brand ahead of the conversation, not just part of it.
Brand Central: the system behind the brand - You’ll build and own WRITER’s brand repository, creating a single, scalable source of truth for assets, guidelines, templates, and toolkits. Working hand-in-hand with the creative team, you’ll turn our brand into something the whole company can activate confidently without compromising consistency. You’ll also champion brand adoption across the organization, running enablement that makes internal teams genuine brand ambassadors.

You’ve spent 7+ years building brands that stand for something, ideally at a high-growth B2B technology company where brand was a strategic imperative.

You’re genuinely excited about agentic AI and its role in brand, and you bring a real point of view. You understand how AI can encode brand standards, scale creative output, and protect consistency without flattening distinctiveness. Ideally, you’ve worked with AI tools in a brand context and have opinions about what works and what doesn’t.
You’ve managed agencies well, which means you’ve written briefs that are actually useful and given feedback that makes work better instead of blander.
You’ve worked in or alongside product teams, and you understand how brand translates into product experiences. You’ve fought those fights and know how to win them.
You’ve built brand systems that scale — asset libraries, guidelines, repositories, brand skills or AI-powered toolkits — that genuinely help teams create on-brand work instead of just paying lip service to the guidelines.
You’re fluent in brand metrics. You know how to measure what matters, connect brand performance to business outcomes, and use data to defend and evolve strategy.
You communicate with precision and confidence. You can write a sharp brief, present a campaign with conviction, and tell a stakeholder why brand investment matters without resorting to platitudes.

Technical & Analytical Skills
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience managing large datasets, campaign trackers, budgets, and reporting files.
Comfort working with acquisition and performance marketing metrics, including CAC, LTV, ROI, conversion, budget tracking, and campaign efficiency.
Experience using data to identify trends, summarize results, and make clear recommendations.
Experience with Tableau, SQL, Looker, or other reporting tools is an asset.
Core Competencies
Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute in a fast-moving environment.
High attention to detail, especially when working with targeting files, creative QA, budgets, vendor timelines, and campaign execution.
An ownership mindset. You take initiative, follow through, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.
Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external partners.
A collaborative approach that brings energy, curiosity, and focus to the team.
A practical AI-first mindset. You are comfortable testing new tools and finding smarter ways to work.
Genuine enthusiasm for HelloFresh’s mission and a hunger to grow.
Additional Assets
Experience working with direct mail, print production, offline acquisition, or performance marketing channels.
Experience at a marketing agency or working closely with agency partners.
Bilingual French proficiency is a plus.

s.h: Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here
s.t:
Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered
Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.
Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
Growth & Development - We support your career progression, provide development opportunities, and invest in your continued learning through our organization wide L&D fund.
Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

Working Conditions
It’s no surprise that as a food company, we use many ingredients that may be considered common allergens (i.e. peanuts, tree nuts, milk, etc.). Whether this role is based out of our headquarters or one of our distribution centers, it is possible that you may be exposed to such allergens in this role. If you have any concerns with being exposed to any particular food ingredients, including meat, please disclose this during the hiring process.

As a Junior Growth Affiliate Manager you’ll play a key role in driving the next phase of growth for the Affiliates channel within the HelloFresh Group. Data is at the core of this role, so the ability to handle mid-level data measurement and thrive within commercial guardrails and targets is essential.

You will support the expansion of our acquisition ecosystem by growing our existing affiliate marketing channel, driving smart efficiency and growth decisions for the UK for both HelloFresh and Green Chef. You will have a deep understanding of the numbers at all times, acting with reactiveness to shifts day to day.

You’ll collaborate closely with local and global Growth Partnerships teams, bringing an innovative, commercial mindset to the channel.
To succeed, you’ll bring hands‑on experience in affiliates and/or partnerships, strong relationship‑building skills, and strategic thinking that fuels long‑term, sustainable growth.
What You Will Be Doing
Support the Growth Partnerships Manager in driving objectives and targets on a monthly basis for the affiliates channel.
Prospecting, pitching, and securing new acquisition‑focused partnerships.
Bringing ideas on best practice for team processes, tools and reporting to drive efficiency.
Manage the housing and optimisation of partner offers to deliver partner value and grow platform reach.
Measurement & analysis against affiliates with a reactive and commercially strategic mindset, negotiating on cost mechanics and pivoting when needed.
Share insights, learnings, and best practices with wider local and international markets to enhance global performance, along with adopting global learnings for local success.

Ideally you have a background in affiliates, performance partnerships, growth marketing, or data handling.
Growth mindset: commercially strategic with a strong foundation in measurement (COS/ROI, CAC, LTV are essential, CVA/CCV is desired), efficiency, incrementality and negotiation.
Ideas-led with the ability to think big and think “brand” - expanding partnership proposals holistically to leverage relevant marketing channels where it adds value.
A natural relationship builder – strong people skills, confident communicator, and able to influence internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to evaluate performance, spot data trends, and ideate and execute regular A/B tests.
Organised, independent, and adaptable with solid project management skills – able to manage multiple conversations, priorities, and deadlines.
A problem solver who quickly identifies barriers and drives solutions.
A collaborative team player who contributes to a positive culture and works seamlessly across teams to achieve shared goals.
Excited by growth, and passionate about building scalable partnerships that deliver long‑term impact and value.

You are required to cooperate with HelloFresh in all health and safety matters. You are responsible for ensuring you take reasonable care of your own health, and safety as well as others who may be affected by the work activities you undertake.

You must report incidents immediately and actively raise health and safety-related concerns to your Line Manager. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure environment, we will process Disclosure and Barring Service ( DBS ) checks to the successful individual.

Failure to disclose relevant information at application or throughout the process could affect your employment with the company.

s.h: The role: What's in the Box
s.t:
Are you ready to turn one of the most prominent e-commerce brands into the Netherlands’ ultimate “Love Brand”? As our Senior Brand Manager NL, you will take full ownership of all brand-related activities for the Dutch market, with a strong social-first lens — commanding both organic and paid social as primary growth levers. Your ultimate goal is to drive Brand Consideration and Brand Equity, deeply embedding our brand into Dutch culture.
This is not a traditional, siloed branding role. You will operate within a fast-paced, complex matrix organization, bridging local execution with global strategy.

We need a commercial, highly strategic marketer who possesses an elite track record in end-to-end campaign management, exceptional agency governance, and specific expertise in driving high- converting D2C retail campaigns that bridge customer centricity with short-term performance.

You live and breathe social media — you know what makes content stop the scroll, and you understand how organic storytelling and paid amplification work together to build both brand love and business results.

Crucially, you will work in lockstep with our Growth Marketing team, ensuring that high-impact brand equity seamlessly fuels the performance funnel to drive scalable business growth.

Drive Local Strategy & Brand Equity: Own and execute a winning brand strategy for the Dutch market that aligns with our global brand framework while staying hyper-relevant to local consumer insights and trends. Social media — both organic and paid — will be your primary channel for building brand salience and cultural relevance.
Lead Social-First Campaign Management: Own the full campaign calendar with a social-first mindset. You design campaigns that are born on social — then extended to ATL, digital, and activations — rather than the other way around.

This includes managing briefs to PCRs for integrated 360° campaigns, Hockey sponsorship, and large influencer collaborations. You will set the organic social content strategy and oversee paid social investment across Meta, TikTok, YouTube and emerging platforms, ensuring both work in concert to maximize reach, engagement, and
conversion.
Own Organic & Paid Social End-to-End: This is a newly elevated priority. You will personally shape the organic social strategy — tone of voice, content pillars, creator partnerships, community moments — and partner closely with the Paid Social team to ensure on what content is needed. You understand full-funnel social: awareness through Reels and TikTok, consideration via UGC and influencer content, and conversion through performance-led paid social campaigns.
Accelerate D2C & Social Commerce: Design and execute high-performing D2C campaigns that treat social commerce as a core acquisition channel. You will know exactly how to leverage performance mechanics and brand storytelling simultaneously to drive acquisition, retention, and brand loyalty.
Navigate the Matrix: Act as a master collaborator within a matrix organization. You will work in close lockstep with local marketing operations (Media, Product Marketing, Growth) and Global Brand teams to ensure seamless alignment and buy-in.
Elevate Agency & Creator Management: Manage, challenge, and inspire our creative, media, PR, and social/influencer agency partners. You will set high standards for output, negotiate effectively, and ensure agencies deliver cutting-edge, thumb-stopping, and cost-effective work. You bring strong instincts for what great social creative looks like —platform-native vs. adapted — and you brief and evaluate accordingly.
Data-Driven Optimization: Turn consumer insights and campaign data into actionable initiatives. You will take tight control of the allocated marketing budget, rigorously tracking KPIs and ROI to prove how brand creativity fuels business metrics. For social, this means owning channel KPIs (reach, engagement rate, share of voice, CPM, CPA, ROAS) and using real-time data to optimise both organic posting cadence and paid spend allocation.
Cultural Relevance & Trend Leadership: Monitor competitive activities and cultural shifts in the Netherlands to inspire the wider team with new developments, buzz-worthy moments, and local brand partnerships. You are chronically online in the best possible way — you spot emerging formats, sounds,
and creators before they peak, and you know how to move fast enough to capitalize on them.

7+ years’ experience in brand management or integrated marketing, with a significant portion in social media strategy (organic and paid).
Proven track record owning social channels end-to-end — strategy, content, community, paid amplification — not just contributing to them.
Deep expertise in Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest and emerging platforms; you can read a paid social dashboard and a content calendar with equal fluency.
Strong creative judgment for social-native content: you know the difference between a great TV ad and a great Reel, and you brief accordingly.
Elite track record in end-to-end 360° campaign management and agency governance.
Experience in D2C or subscription e-commerce environments; understanding of performance marketing funnels.
Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate insights into commercial action.
Exceptional stakeholder management skills in a matrix organization.
Fluent in Dutch and English (written and spoken).
Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. There are many different ways of developing skills, and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.
Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

Enjoy 20% off HelloFresh and 40% off Factor_ subscriptions.
Access the " Benefits at Work " platform for discounts on brands like Nike, Bol.com, and IKEA.
You'll receive a HelloFresh laptop, a €250 home office setup budget, and contribute to the Bedrijfspensioenfonds Levensmiddelen pension scheme (2026 rate 27.6%; employer pays 19.64%, employee pays 7.96%).
Health & Wellbeing
Benefit from discounts on ClassPass and gym memberships via Bedrijfsfitness Nederland, free bootcamp classes (Amsterdam), and free subscriptions to Headspace and OpenUp.
Get a 7,5% discount on additional health insurance at Zilveren Kruis in 2025.
Flexibility & Work-Life
Work flexibly with our hybrid setup (50% office, 50% remote), plus a €2.40 daily remote work allowance.
Receive 24 days of annual leave (pro-rated), plus one additional day per year of service (up to 30 days total).
Full reimbursement for 2nd-class public transport to the office, plus €0.23 per km for car and bicycle travel.
Eligible employees can work from another country for up to 8 weeks per year.
Career & Development
Grow with our "Learning Never Stops" mindset: access internal/external opportunities, and join our cross-market mentoring program.

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.
With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.
Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement.

We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We’re looking for a Product and Solutions Marketing Manager to help drive go-to-market for LangSmith Fleet and build the solutions marketing motion around enterprise AI adoption.
Fleet is LangChain’s product for bringing agents to every team in an organization. It enables anyone to build, use, and manage agents with natural language, while giving organizations the security, observability, and API extensibility they need to deploy agents across the business.
This role will help shape how we take Fleet to market across both sales-led and product-led growth motions. You’ll work on positioning and messaging, product launches, content, enablement, campaigns, customer storytelling, and cross-functional programs in partnership with product, sales, education, and marketing.
The audience is broad and nuanced: technical buyers who care about security, observability, integrations, APIs, and governance; technical champions who want to extend and operationalize agents; and nontechnical users who need to understand what agents can do for their day-to-day work. You’ll help translate a rapidly evolving product into clear stories, content, and programs that drive awareness, adoption, and revenue.
You’ll also help turn LangChain’s broader platform story into industry-specific solutions. That includes developing campaigns, collateral, and sales enablement for targeted enterprise segments such as financial services, healthcare, and life sciences. You’ll work closely with product, sales, demand generation, field marketing, education, and customer-facing teams to translate customer problems into clear narratives, programs, and assets that support pipeline and revenue.

Product marketing for Fleet
Help launch new Fleet capabilities in a fast-moving market. You’ll partner with product and GTM teams to bring new features and use cases to market.
Develop positioning and messaging for Fleet. You’ll help define how Fleet shows up across the website, sales materials, launch assets, campaigns, product pages, and customer-facing content.
Create content that helps different audiences understand and adopt Fleet. This may include launch blogs, solution briefs, use case pages, customer stories, comparison pages, demo narratives, sales decks, guides, and campaign assets.
Build enablement for a sales-led motion. You’ll help equip sales and customer-facing teams with talk tracks, objection handling, discovery questions, demo narratives, competitive context, and materials that help them speak to technical buyers and business stakeholders.
Partner with demand generation on campaigns. You’ll help turn product narratives, use cases, launches, and customer insights into campaigns that drive pipeline and product adoption.
Stay close to customers and the market. You’ll synthesize customer conversations, sales feedback, product usage signals, competitive activity, and market trends into insights that improve our messaging, roadmap inputs, and GTM strategy.
Solutions and enterprise marketing
Develop solution narratives for priority industries and enterprise use cases. Initial focus areas include financial services, healthcare, and life sciences, with room to expand based on GTM priorities.
Partner with demand generation, field marketing, and sales on integrated campaigns. You’ll create campaign materials and collateral for targeted enterprise motions. This may include solution briefs, industry landing page copy, campaign messaging, and webinar narratives.
Build sales enablement for enterprise conversations. You’ll create materials that help account teams explain LangChain’s value in regulated and complex environments, including industry talk tracks, use case maps, executive-ready decks, and objection handling.
Translate customer and field insights into repeatable sales plays. You’ll work with sales, solutions, and customer-facing teams to understand what resonates in the field and turn that into reusable messaging, collateral, and campaign programs.

You have current experience in product marketing, developer marketing, solutions marketing, enterprise marketing, or a related GTM role.
You’ve worked on technical products, developer tools, AI/ML products, B2B SaaS, infrastructure, automation, productivity tools, or platform products.
You can translate technical concepts into clear customer-facing messaging. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable learning technical products and asking good questions.
You’re excited by a product that serves multiple audiences: developers, technical buyers, operators, admins, and nontechnical end users.
You understand how sales-led and product-led motions can work together. You can create materials that help sales teams win while also helping self-serve users understand and adopt the product.
You understand enterprise marketing. You know how to create assets and campaigns for complex buying committees, regulated industries, and sales-led motions.
You write clearly and quickly. You can turn a product capability, customer problem, or technical workflow into useful content or enablement without a long ramp.
You like working cross-functionally. You’ll partner closely with product, sales, demand generation, field marketing, devrel, education, customer-facing teams, and the broader marketing team.
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and iteration. Fleet is evolving quickly, and the market for workplace agents is still being defined. You’re excited to ship, learn, and improve.
You have genuine curiosity about agents, enterprise AI adoption, and how they will change how teams work.
You use AI tools in your own work and are interested in finding new ways to increase your effectiveness with them.
Experience marketing developer tools, AI products, automation products, productivity tools, or enterprise SaaS platforms.

Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies.

With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Marketing Manager, Employer Brand to lead the strategy, development, and execution of our global employer brand marketing efforts. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role responsible for shaping how we attract, engage, and convert top-tier talent across technical and mission-critical domains.
You will own the employer brand marketing strategy end-to-end—from audience segmentation and storytelling to channel strategy, campaign execution, and performance measurement. You’ll partner closely with Recruiting, Communications, and leadership to position Shield AI as a destination for builders, engineers, and operators driven by mission and impact.
This role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution—someone who can define the vision while also building and launching campaigns in a fast-moving environment.

Employer Brand Strategy & Positioning
Lead and evolve Shield AI’s employer brand marketing strategy to attract high-caliber talent across technical, defense, and corporate functions
Define target talent segments and craft differentiated messaging aligned to mission, product, and impact
Shape and scale a compelling employer value proposition grounded in real employee stories and business priorities
Social & Channel Strategy
Define and lead Shield AI’s global employer brand social media strategy across platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram, emerging channels), aligned to hiring priorities and talent segments
Own the end-to-end social ecosystem—including channel positioning, content strategy, editorial planning, publishing, and performance optimization
Build and scale a distinct, mission-driven social voice that differentiates Shield AI and resonates with technical and mission-oriented talent
Partner with Communications and Brand teams to ensure alignment between corporate, product, and employer narratives while tailoring for talent audiences
Establish and operationalize a content engine for social, including employee storytelling, behind-the-scenes content, and campaign amplification
Launch and optimize paid + organic social programs to drive awareness, engagement, and candidate conversion
Implement testing frameworks (creative, format, audience, platform) to continuously improve performance and inform channel investment strategy
Campaigns, Content & Channels
Lead the development and execution of integrated recruitment marketing campaigns across digital, social, and emerging channels
Own content strategy across the candidate journey—from awareness through conversion—including careers site, social media, and campaign assets
Partner with internal teams to bring authentic employee and mission-driven stories to life
Build scalable content and campaign frameworks that enable recruiting teams to engage talent more effectively
Analytics, Insights & Optimization
Define success metrics and build reporting frameworks to measure employer brand performance across channels and campaigns
Translate data and candidate insights into actionable recommendations that improve targeting, messaging, and conversion
Design and execute media and channel experiments to optimize performance and inform investment strategy
Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence
Partner closely with Recruiting, Communications, Product Marketing, and Leadership to align employer brand efforts with hiring priorities and company narrative
Act as a thought leader and advisor to stakeholders on talent market trends, candidate behavior, and employer brand strategy
Enable recruiters and hiring leaders with tools, insights, and best practices to strengthen candidate engagement
Programs & Operations
Manage employer brand marketing budgets and external partners where applicable
Identify opportunities to extend employer brand impact beyond top-of-funnel attraction into deeper stages of the candidate journey
Build scalable systems, processes, and playbooks to support rapid company growth

Bachelor's degree in marketing, Communications, or a related field
8 years of experience in marketing, with a focus on employer brand, talent marketing, or digital marketing
Proven track record of developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable results
Strong analytical skills with experience using data to inform strategy and optimize performance
Deep understanding of digital channels, social platforms, and content strategy

Experience in high-growth technology, AI, robotics, defense, or mission-driven environments
Experience marketing to technical talent (e.g., software engineers, AI/ML, robotics)
Strong storytelling instincts with the ability to translate complex technology and mission into compelling narratives
Exceptional cross-functional leadership and influencing skills in matrixed organizations
Experience building employer brand measurement frameworks and running multi-channel campaigns
MBA or advanced degree a plus

Who Are We?
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

Postman is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to drive pipeline growth and in-market execution across the UK. This role sits within Revenue Marketing and is focused on bringing regional campaign strategy to life in one of our most mature and competitive markets.

You’ll execute high-impact programs that engage developers, product teams, and enterprise buyers — with a strong emphasis on deal acceleration and executive engagement. You’ll partner closely with sales to ensure marketing is aligned to priority accounts and pipeline needs, and you’ll play a key role in how Postman shows up in-market across the UK.
We’re looking for someone who thinks in terms of pipeline, not programs — and knows how to execute in ways that move deals forward.
What You’ll Own
UK Pipeline Contribution & In-Market Execution
Execute regional marketing plans aligned to UK pipeline goals
Focus on driving pipeline creation, acceleration, and deal progression
Align programs to territory plans, key accounts, and pipeline gaps
Integrated Campaign Execution (Field + Digital + ABM)

In-person events and executive experiences
Webinars and virtual programs
Account-based marketing (1:few, 1:many)
Always-on digital support
Support campaigns across the full funnel, with strong focus on late-stage acceleration
Sales Partnership & Account Engagement
Operate in a GTM pod model with tight partnership with UK AEs and ADR teams to:
Prioritize target accounts
Execute account engagement plans
Support active opportunities
Bring marketing into deals to improve win rates and velocity
Events & Field Programs

Executive roundtables and VIP experiences
Industry events and sponsorships
Targeted hosted experiences
Focus on depth of engagement and pipeline impact
Performance & Pipeline Accountability
Track performance against pipeline and engagement KPIs
Optimize execution based on what drives results
Maintain visibility into UK marketing contribution to revenue

Experience
5–8+ years in field marketing or demand generation in B2B SaaS
Experience executing campaigns in a mature, enterprise-focused market
Strong track record of sales partnership and account engagement
Skills & Approach
Thinks in terms of pipeline, accounts, and revenue
Strong execution across integrated channels
Comfortable supporting late-stage deals and executive engagement
Data-driven and performance-focused
What Success Looks Like
Strong contribution to UK pipeline
High-impact programs that support deal acceleration
Tight alignment with sales on accounts and opportunities
Consistent execution of high-quality field programs
What Else?
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend.

Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about.

We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year.

We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Product Marketing is responsible for developing crisp, highly differentiated, and compelling positioning and messaging for Postman and its services. We enable the revenue team to tell stories that educate customers about what is possible when they choose Postman to manage every API and service across their organization.
As a Senior or Staff Product Marketing Manager, you will have the opportunity to create compelling content to help customers, especially platform engineers, and developers understand their use cases and value propositions, and build the right marketing programs to drive awareness, engagement, service adoption, and retention.
This role sits in San Francisco, CA only.

Act as a product marketing lead for Postman features and services, and take ownership of the strategy to drive awareness and market penetration of key capabilities
Work with engineering teams to distill key functionality and benefits into customer facing value messaging
Craft compelling, and differentiated outbound product messaging and content (like blogs, videos, tutorials, web pages, webinars, social media that resonate with target personas.
Enable the field on our solutions, through training and content (e.g. pitch decks and playbooks, etc)
Plan and implement feature and service launches (with operational marketing teams), including creating launch materials and content to support and coordinate with team members
Support Postman events, third party trade shows and other events to help showcase our products to attendees.

Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting

Experience crafting engaging content for developers

About Addi
We are a leading financial platform, building the future of payments, shopping, and banking—a world where consumers and merchants can transact effortlessly and grow together. Today, we serve over 2 million customers and partner with more than 20,000 merchants, making Addi Colombia’s fastest-growing marketplace.
With a state-of-the-art, technology-first approach, we provide banking solutions (deposits, payments, unsecured credit) and commerce services (e-commerce, marketing), bridging the financial gap for millions and redefining how people experience financial freedom.

As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. In the past year, we have also achieved profitability, reinforcing the strength of our business model and our ability to scale sustainably.
Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. But what truly sets us apart is how we build. We are a conscious company, driven by deep experience in scaling technology, services and products, and we live by our values every day.

This is where you come in. Below, you’ll find what this role is all about—the impact you’ll drive, the challenges you’ll tackle, and what it takes to thrive at Addi. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading.
What’s the mission you’ll drive
Lead Addi’s B2B Marketing function as an AI-first operating system, driving merchant GMV growth by scaling the Activation and Growth Playbook (PAC) end-to-end. Strengthen Marketing-Sales Alignment: Establish a formal marketing-to-sales handoff with the commercial team by Q4, increasing collaboration, pipeline visibility, and engagement across priority accounts.
Build an AI-First Operating System: Deploy production-ready AI agents to support key marketing workflows, including account research, content creation, and CRM journey quality assurance.

About Supercell

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.

Oversee production across non-owned channels, events, and activations, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
Track campaign performance and player response, sharing insights with stakeholders.
Continuously improve execution quality by applying learnings and raising the bar over time.
Capture learnings, identify execution improvements and proactively recommend ways to improve future campaigns.

Strong experience executing marketing campaigns in EMEA and ideally DACH markets, France and the UK - preferably in gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands.
Deep understanding of DACH media, culture, and player behavior.
Hands-on experience across digital and social marketing, including influencer and creator collaborations.
Familiarity with broader media channels such as TV, CTV, audio, and out-of-home.
Proven ability to manage complex projects, timelines, and budgets.
Experience working with international teams across time zones.

Experience executing campaigns across EMEA.

s.t:
Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.

Trainiere deine Geschmacksnerven . Bei uns ist jeder der Lust hat Teil unseres Sensory-Teams. Probiere also neue Produkte, Sorten oder Geschmäcker vor allen anderen. Ansonsten gibt es so viel yfood wie du tragen kannst, natürlich auch für dich gratis.
Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen . Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

Design, plan, and execute complementary social media campaigns to amplify marketing collateral and increase brand visibility.
Develop strategies to leverage social media channels effectively, engaging target audiences and driving traffic to key campaign assets.

Drive growth across all M3 market research companies by developing comprehensive marketing campaigns that support their objectives and integrate seamlessly with existing initiatives.
Control and measure resources available for specific initiatives, allocating and prioritising resources to maximise return on investment (ROI).

5+ years in performance marketing with a clear specialization in paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, or similar) rather than search.
Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six-figure+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Braze, Product Marketing sits at the center of how we bring our platform to market—shaping the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that connect what we build to the value our customers feel.

As part of our Product Marketing team, you'll own narratives and GTM for the strategic technology partnerships that extend what's possible on our platform.

This is a role for a builder and a storyteller: someone energized by turning complex offerings into clear, compelling go-to-market programs, and who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with teams across Product, Sales, Partnership, and Marketing to bring them to life.

You will translate Braze's strategic technology partnerships into differentiated messaging, joint go-to-market programs, and field-ready assets that ladder up to our core platform narrative.
This is an individual contributor role focused on strong PMM craft and cross-functional execution. You'll bring a clear understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, and you'll work closely with internal cross-functional teams including Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to take initiatives from messaging through to field readiness.
GTM Strategy & Messaging
Develop GTM strategy based on joint business plans for strategic technology partnerships in collaboration with partner leads
Own the messaging architecture for Braze's strategic technology partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers and data platforms), ensuring each partnership ladders up to our core platform narrative and customer engagement story
Translate platform integrations into clear, differentiated value propositions with defined customer use cases and competitive angles
Work with Core Product Marketing to ensure technology partners are reflected accurately in product launches, campaigns, and core messaging
GTM Execution & Enablement
Drive joint go-to-market and co-marketing programs with technology platform partners, coordinating timelines and deliverables across internal teams
Drive partner launch motions end-to-end: messaging, packaging, enablement materials, and field readiness
Build and deliver core assets and enablement that actually get used in the field
Track performance and adoption, and report results back to cross-functional stakeholders
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with Product, GTM Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Partnership to align on priorities and execute against them
Partner with Sales and the field to support active deals, customer conversations, and positioning
What Success Looks Like

s.h: In your first year, success means
s.t:
A repeatable launch and enablement motion for technology platform partnerships, with integrations reflected consistently across launches, campaigns, and core messaging
Trusted, productive relationships across Product, Sales, Partners, Marketing, and Services—you're the person teams pull in early

A storyteller. You turn complex offerings and integrations into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with buyers and the field alike
A builder. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure, frameworks, and repeatable motions where none existed
A collaborator. You're a sleeves-rolled-up, low-ego operator who brings cross-functional teams along and gets things shipped without direct authority
GTM-fluent. You understand how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners and how to execute them in a fast-moving, matrixed organization

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
7–10+ years in product and/or partner marketing at a growing B2B technology company, with strong product marketing (PMM) craft at the core
A clear, practical understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, including joint GTM programs, co-marketing motions, and integration launches
Strong PMM fundamentals: messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, narrative development, and the ability to translate complex offerings and integrations into clear, buyer-ready stories
Experience marketing technology platform partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and the broader SaaS/martech ecosystem)
Experience building sales and enablement content—solution briefs, battle cards, decks, playbooks—that gets adopted and used by the field
A proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and execute without direct authority, navigating a matrixed organization to get things shipped
Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and partners

Experience in customer engagement, marketing technology, CDP, or adjacent data/SaaS categories

Joining Consensys means working with a fully remote, globally distributed team of technologists, designers, cryptographers, product thinkers, and researchers who are building the next layer of the internet.

Consensys alumni have moved on to become tech entrepreneurs, CEOs, and team leads at tech companies.

Oversee the lifecycle strategy across Consensys’ product offering (e.g. in-app notifications, in-app banners, push notifications, full screen modals,, etc)
Determine the channel and messaging throughout a user’s lifecycle (new user education, activation, engagement, retention)
Comfortable working end-to-end on a lifecycle campaign (through setting the strategy, briefing the creative team, building the targeting, QAing the campaign, and measuring results)
Develop an experimentation roadmap across lifecycle channels. Continuously test and learn, identifying the most effective content and messages for different audiences.

4-8 years of experience in lifecycle marketing
Have built lifecycle user journeys from the ground up with little to no oversight on large userbases
Excellent project management skills to manage multiple experiments at different points in their development
Practical experience executing in CEP systems such as Braze
Familiar with marketing and analytical tools like Segment, Mixpanel, and Preset
Self starter who is data-driven, results-oriented and customer-obsessed

Web3 experience will be a bonus

Team mission

GetYourGuide is revolutionising the tours and activities space, fundamentally changing how people discover and book activities at their destination. Innovative and effective Performance Marketing is the driving force of our success. We take a data-driven approach to connect customers’ intent with the right inventory in our marketplace.

We believe in building scalable channels by working in cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Data Science, Content, Design) to build the best marketing automation in the industry. We are looking for an outstanding Paid Search Marketing Manager to join our Berlin HQ.

Be a part of one of Berlin’s most innovative and cutting-edge Performance Marketing teams and gain exposure to a large-scale, highly automated marketing engine.

· Conduct comprehensive data analysis to identify trends and patterns and formulate hypotheses around the improvement of our content and coverage structure.
