We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.

We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Why this role is on the menu
Instacart is the leading online grocery company in Canada, serving 98% of households across 10 provinces and 100 retail banners. The grocery delivery category is competitive and growing rapidly, and this role is responsible for building Instacart’s brand and business in Canada.
We’re looking for a Marketing Manager II to own consumer marketing for Canada. You’ll be responsible for the national go-to-market strategy and execution across integrated campaigns, local content, and partnerships — working closely with our brand, media, creative, CRM, and agency partners to deliver work that drives measurable outcomes and makes an impact locally. This role reports to the Director, Partnerships & Strategic Audience Marketing.
This is a high-ownership role on a lean, fast-moving team. You’ll move fluidly between campaign strategy and execution — developing briefs, partnering with cross-functional teams, and executing.

On the partnership side, you’ll serve as a trusted external counterpart to partners and agencies, bringing equal parts rigor and creativity from brief through performance review.

The ideal candidate brings sound judgment, a genuine feel for what resonates with Canadian consumers, and the discipline to deliver quality work across multiple concurrent programs.
What you'll cook up in your first year
Instacart’s Canadian brand and business growth is informed by deep consumer, category, and competitive insights — with you as the resident expert on the Canadian audience.
Canada-led and US-adapted marketing campaigns are executed end-to-end — from strategic brief through creative development and performance evaluation — in close collaboration with cross-functional partners.
The Canadian influencer program produces local, engaging content that fuels performance, developed in close partnership with our media team and agency partners.
Key brand partnerships are activated to deepen Instacart’s connection with local audiences through culturally relevant, distinct activations.
Campaigns and content reaching Canadian consumers are accurate, culturally relevant, and on brand — with localization expertise applied across owned and paid content.
Canada procurement processes and monthly marketing budget tracking are managed on time and with precision.

5+ years of progressive experience in brand marketing, integrated campaign marketing, or partner marketing with a strong focus on campaign strategy and execution, preferably within a consumer tech company with a US-based company navigating Canada as a distinct market
Deep understanding of Canadian culture and market nuance, including regional differences across the country and experience reaching consumers in Quebec
Demonstrable experience leading complex, integrated go-to-market strategies for significant brand initiatives or product launches
A proven ability to balance strategic thinking with creative vision, translating business goals into compelling brand narratives and breakthrough campaigns
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently present and influence at all levels, including executive leadership
Excellent project management skills, capable of managing multiple complex projects simultaneously, meeting tight deadlines, and thriving in a dynamic, lean environment
A natural collaborator who excels at building consensus and leading diverse cross-functional teams towards shared goals
Proficient in using data and insights to inform strategy, measure campaign effectiveness, and drive continuous optimization
Nimble, resourceful, and detail-oriented, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and adapt quickly in a fast-evolving industry
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent practical experience

Familiar with Québécois culture and bilingual

As Senior Event Marketing Manager at Databricks, you will report to the Director of Corporate Events and collaborate with global teams. You will lead field initiatives and sales enablement for major events like the Data + AI Summit and World Tour. Your focus will be delivering premium field experiences, activating Sales colleagues, refining workflows, and strengthening cross-functional alignment to scale these programs and their business impact.
Impact Statement
Within the first one to two years, success in this role will look like:
Flagship events such as Data + AI Summit and World Tour are consistently treated as strategic field growth engines, with clear motions that translate event engagement into high-quality opportunities and healthy pipeline for priority and strategic accounts.
Clear targeting frameworks (including quotas, eligibility to attend, and strategic account selection) are defined with sales leadership, so the right customers, partners, and reps are prioritized for each program.
Field teams have a simple, repeatable event playbook (pre-, during, and post-event) that is widely adopted, with strong participation in event campaigns and follow-up activities from sales, marketing, and partner teams.
Attendee and customer experiences across field-focused programs are cohesive and premium from invitation through post-event follow-up, resulting in stronger relationships with strategic accounts, partners, and executive stakeholders.
Event performance is transparently tracked through agreed-upon dashboards and reports built in partnership with analytics and operations, giving leaders clear visibility into attendance, engagement, and downstream revenue impact to inform future investment decisions.
Lead flow from events into sales systems is reliable and timely, with well-structured campaigns, lead routing, and MQL definitions that enable BDR/SDR teams to act quickly and consistently on event leads.
Incentive structures (such as SPIFFs and recognition programs) are thoughtfully used to drive meaningful field engagement with event motions, without creating unnecessary complexity for sales or operations.
Cross-functional programs such as executive forums, partner summits, product announcements, and training and certifications are integrated into a unified field event strategy, so that messaging, targeting, and experiences feel connected for customers and internal teams, and internal stakeholders see the program as well-run with clear goals, communications, and meeting cadences that reduce friction and allow them to focus on driving outcomes.
What we look for

s.h: To achieve the outcomes above, you bring
s.t:
Extensive experience leading complex B2B marketing events or event portfolios end-to-end, including ownership for business impact and not just execution.
Proven track record partnering closely with sales and field teams to design event strategies, plays, and enablement that drive measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, agencies, and stakeholders while maintaining clarity on goals, budgets, and timelines.
Deep comfort working with CRM, marketing, and analytics tools to define targets, interpret event performance, and make data-informed recommendations about where to focus and how to improve.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and represent the event strategy and results clearly.
A metrics-driven, test-and-learn mindset, continually looking for ways to improve attendee experience, field engagement, and event ROI through experimentation and refinement.
Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: setting the overall field event vision and frameworks while also diving into the details needed to ensure world-class execution.

Partner Marketing exists to fuel the growth and success of Wellhub's global partner network of gyms, studios and wellness businesses. The Senior Manager, Partner Marketing (France & Benelux) leads Partner Marketing strategy and execution for these markets, as part of Wellhub's regional EU Partner Marketing team.
This person will act as the regional Point of Contact (POC) for Partner Marketing in France and Benelux, owning the local Business-to- Partner value proposition, brand positioning, network growth and engagement and, fitness industry events, working closely with Partnerships, local and cross-functional Marketing, Wellbeing Engagement, Product Development and Revenue teams to align strategy and execution.

Reporting to the Partner Marketing Director, EU, this role combines strategic ownership of the region with hands-on execution.
This role directly impacts the growth and satisfaction of Wellhub's partner network in France and Benelux, contributing to the team's broader goals around partner network growth, partner engagement, and partner satisfaction (PSAT).

Market-Specific Value Proposition: Develop and implement the local Business to Partner value proposition across all partner-facing materials and touchpoints for France and Benelux.
Brand Awareness & Positioning: Build Wellhub's presence and credibility within the regional fitness industry through relationships with industry associations/alliances, sponsorships, events, media/publications, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
Strategic Partner Growth (B2P2C): Lead go-to-market strategy for partner launches, relaunches, and dedicated campaigns and promotions to end users and clients, driving growth with existing partners.
Strategic Partner Engagement: Build partner trust through structured engagement initiatives, including fitness industry events, partner conferences and summits.
Network Growth Support: Support the Demand Generation team’s strategy with local market insights and develop sales enablement materials to drive growth across the partner network.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Partnerships, User Growth, Corporate communication, Content, Revenue teams local and global level to align initiatives with company-wide strategy.
Budget Ownership: Manage the regional Partner Marketing budget for France and Benelux, allocating resources across campaigns, events and other marketing initiatives to drive results and maximize ROI.
Data-Driven Marketing: Use performance data and partner insights to inform, prioritize and continuously optimize Partner Marketing initiatives in the region.
AI-Driven Productivity: Autonomously identify and apply AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to raise the team's level of automation — streamlining repetitive tasks, accelerating content, reporting and campaign production, and embedding AI-assisted workflows into day-to-day ways of working. Continuously build personal AI fluency and share practices that help the broader team work smarter.
Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Native/fluent in French and fluent in English, based in France with deep knowledge of local market and fitness industry culture.
Working knowledge of Dutch is a plus, given the scope across Benelux markets.
[+8] years of experience in Marketing, ideally with exposure to Partner, Channel, Product or Revenue Marketing in a B2B or B2B2C environment.
Proven ability to build value propositions, brand positioning and go-to-market strategies, and to execute them independently as a regional lead.
Comfortable managing institutional relationships with industry KOLs, associations and strategic partners.
Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
Data-driven approach to marketing decisions, comfortable with CRM and marketing analytics tools.
Fluent English is mandatory.

As a Brand Manager for VALORANT Eastern Europe, you will lead the strategic and tactical delivery of publishing across multiple markets, translating VALORANT’s global vision into a cohesive, multi‑market strategy that drives deep player engagement and meaningful business results. You will act as the senior publishing leader for your region, connecting product direction, marketing strategy, and esports delivery to create authentic and impactful experiences for players.

You will be accountable for defining and executing publishing strategies that balance global consistency with local relevance, ensuring that each market’s cultural and competitive context is reflected in how we show up. Partnering closely with global and regional product leadership, you will influence product priorities, shape multi‑market go‑to‑market plans, and guide execution across campaigns, creator partnerships, esports integrations, and community initiatives.

Operating at both a strategic and tactical level, you will lead cross‑functional teams, manage significant budgets, and act as the primary advocate for your markets to global leadership. Your ability to connect insight‑driven strategy with high‑impact execution will be critical in growing VALORANT’s presence, deepening community connection, and delivering on both player and business outcomes.

Reporting to the Publishing Manager DACH & Eastern Europe, the Brand Manager Eastern Europe will be based in Berlin (Germany).

· Develop and own a cohesive multi‑market publishing strategy for your region that delivers against global product goals and local player needs

· Translate global product priorities into tailored market plans that maximize player engagement and business impact

· Act as the primary publishing voice for your region in global product discussions, shaping product and publishing decisions with regional insight

· Lead integrated go‑to‑market plans that connect product beats, esports moments, creator activations, and cultural opportunities

· Oversee large‑scale budgets, making data‑driven investment decisions across multiple markets

· Build, guide, and align cross‑disciplinary teams across publishing, esports, community, creative, and commercial functions

· Track and assess performance across campaigns and markets, applying insights to continuously optimize strategy and execution

· Cultivate strong relationships with regional partners, media, agencies, and key influencers to amplify VALORANT’s impact across your cluster

· 7+ years in publishing, marketing, or product management, preferably in games, entertainment, or tech

· Proven experience leading high‑impact, multi‑market campaigns from strategic planning through to execution

· Demonstrated ability to influence product direction through market insight and player advocacy

· Strong leadership skills with experience managing cross‑functional and distributed teams

· Deep understanding of FPS gaming culture and the VALORANT player community

· Exceptional communication skills, fluent in Polish and English

· Strong budget ownership experience with a track record of maximizing ROI across multiple markets

· Experience driving publishing strategy for major game launches or sustained live service products across multiple countries

· Proven success integrating esports, live events, and cultural moments into holistic brand strategies

· Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with the ability to translate complex insights into actionable publishing tactics

· Experience mentoring and developing other publishing professionals

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

We are seeking a versatile marketing leader to manage our marketing engagement across Europe. As our first local marketing person in the region, you will design and execute a comprehensive GTM strategy that accounts for the diverse cultural, economic, and linguistic landscape of Europe.
You will be responsible for identifying high-growth clusters, navigating complex regulatory environments, and building a unified brand voice that resonates across multiple borders. Your work will span social, influencers, partner, and event marketing. You will be the fulcrum of all the region's outbound activity.
Location: Netherlands (plus a few weeks at HQ for an extended orientation)

Holistic Regional Strategy: Design a scalable marketing framework that can be adapted for Tier 1 European markets (high volume/established) and Tier 2/3 markets (high growth).
Localized Content Ecosystem: Oversee the "transcreation" and localization of all marketing assets. While English is our core working language, you will ensure our brand voice translates with native-level nuance across key European regions, leveraging your German or French skills where applicable.
Agile GTM Execution: Lead product launches across Europe, prioritizing markets based on data, barriers to entry, and localized product-market fit.
Cross-Border Community & Influencer Growth: Leverage regional social media and platform trends to build a loyal community through targeted influencer partnerships and localized channels (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, etc.).
Policy & Comms Collaboration: Work closely with legal and policy teams to navigate the varied regulatory landscapes of Europe, ensuring absolute compliance with GDPR and local data privacy standards.
Event & Ecosystem Strategy: Develop locally relevant events and community initiatives across key priority European markets, while also participating in existing industry events that support relationship building, market understanding and ecosystem growth.
Strategic Market Partnerships: Build and develop trusted partnerships with brands, NGOs, across key European markets to strengthen local credibility, relevance and long-term growth, while deepening engagement with creators, industry stakeholders and broader market ecosystems.

8+ years of marketing experience with a deep, pan-regional focus across Europe.
Independent Drive: Proven ability to operate autonomously within a strategic framework, driving clear outcomes with minimal day-to-day oversight.
Language Proficiency: Absolute professional fluency in English. The ability to understand, speak, or review content in German and/or French is a plus.
Broad Market Knowledge: Experience managing marketing efforts in highly fragmented environments—from varying audience demographics and cultural perceptions to distinct European economic climates.
5+ years in Consumer Tech: Deep understanding of the European consumer journey, specifically privacy-first user behaviors, mobile trends, and local trust barriers.
Strategic Influence: Proven ability to advocate effectively for regional European needs (budget, product localized features, compliance requirements) to a global/US-based HQ.
Data-Driven test and learn mentality: Ability to drive growth and iterate quickly by being resourceful, analytical, and hands-on.
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

This isn't a pure logistics role: you're the person who helps shape how Ahrefs shows up at events visually and strategically, from audience campaigns to booth design to swag.

For fulfillment and operational execution, you'll partner closely with our Singapore-based Event Operations Manager. You own the creative brief and speaker relationships; they own making it happen on the ground.

Lead event marketing strategy and execution — audience targeting, multi-channel campaigns (email, social, partnerships, content), registration drives, and post-event follow-up.
Serve as the single point of contact for Ahrefs Evolve confirmed speakers — from the moment a booking is made by the influencer team through to post-event follow-up. Speakers should never need to wonder who to contact: you own the relationship, the briefing, and the experience. You'll relay logistics requirements to the Event Operations Manager so speakers deal with one person throughout.
Own creative direction for Evolve, our global annual conference — including fabrication, booth design, and overall brand experience, briefing and working closely with designers across Europe and Asia.
Manage sponsorship booth design and creative for European field events and regional activations.
Lead swag creative direction: concept, design standards, and brand alignment — coordinating with the Event Operations Manager, who owns vendor management and fulfillment.
Collaborate with the Global Head of Events and Global Partnerships & Revenue Manager on Evolve strategy and sponsorship activation planning.
Manage timelines and creative vendor relationships across multiple concurrent projects.
Build and maintain relationships with regional communities, partners, and event venues across Europe.
Provide cross-regional creative support for select events in Singapore and the US, ensuring consistency across all markets.
Track and report on event performance — attendance, engagement, brand impact, and ROI.
You'll Thrive Here If
You've run B2B field marketing programs or event portfolios with both large-scale and grassroots activations.
You're a strong event marketer with solid creative instincts — you understand audience segmentation, campaign mechanics, and how to build an experience that drives registration and engagement.
You've managed fabrication, booth design, or brand experience at events — you know how to brief designers, hold vendors to a standard, and translate a brand into a physical space.
You understand where your ownership ends and your operational partner's begins — you hand off a complete, approved brief and trust execution to follow.

You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
You're based in the UK or Europe and comfortable with occasional travel across the region, and to the US & Singapore.

Introduction
Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?
Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.
Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit.
Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir.
What's in it for me
Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead.
Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren.
Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.
How you can make an impact
Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen.
Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen.
Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen.
Content & Kreation: Du entwickelst Formate und Inhalte, die bei unseren Zielgruppen ankommen, und testest kontinuierlich, was wirklich performt - datenbasiert statt Bauchgefühl.
Marketing-Infrastruktur: Du baust eine skalierbare Infrastruktur auf - von HubSpot-Automation über Lead-Tracking bis hin zu verlässlichem Reporting.
KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt aktiv KI-Tools, um Prozesse zu automatisieren - von der Content-Produktion bis hin zu personalisierten Kampagnen.
Agentur-Steuerung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Marketing-Agentur, briefst Kampagnen, gibst Feedback und stellst sicher, dass Ergebnisse geliefert werden.
Sales-Marketing-Alignment: Du bist die aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb und stellst sicher, dass Leads nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden.
Skills to be successful
Erste echte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise im B2B SaaS-, Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur betreut, sondern eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und bist damit auch mal auf die Nase gefallen. Beides ist wertvoll.
Akademischer Hintergrund: Abschluss einer Top-Universität oder mit überdurchschnittlichen Noten in Marketing, BWL, Kommunikation o. ä.
Performance-Marketing-Kompetenz: Du kennst dich mit Paid Media auf Google und LinkedIn aus, weißt wie man Kampagnen aufsetzt, optimiert und bewertet. Längere Sales-Cycles und komplexe Buying Center sind dir nicht fremd.
Zahlenaffinität: Bei uns wird alles gemessen und getrackt. Du scheust dich nicht vor Dashboards und KPIs, sondern nutzt sie als Kompass für deine tägliche Arbeit. Zahlen sind für dich die Basis jeder Entscheidung, nicht lästige Pflicht.
HubSpot & Automation: Erfahrung mit HubSpot Marketing Hub - idealerweise inkl. Segmentierung, Automation und Attribution - ist ein klares Plus.
KI-Affinität: Du hast Berührungspunkte mit KI-gestützten Tools in der Content-Produktion oder Lead-Generierung und bist neugierig, das weiterzuentwickeln.
Kreatives Auge: Du hast ein Gespür für Sprache und Design - für LinkedIn-Posts genauso wie für Kampagnen-Creatives. Erfahrung mit Canva oder Adobe Creative Cloud ist ein Plus.
Extreme Ownership: Du brauchst niemanden, der dir sagt was zu tun ist. Wenn du eine Chance siehst, ergreifst du sie. Wenn Hindernisse kommen, überspringst du sie. Du gehst voran.
Kommunikation & Kollaboration: Du kommunizierst klar und präzise - intern wie extern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Product and Lifecycle Marketing team. In this role, you'll design and optimize lifecycle programs that engage, retain, and grow members across their entire journey with Chime—from top of funnel through long-term retention—with a clear focus on driving growth, revenue, and member lifetime value (LTV).
This is a role for a holistic, business-minded marketer rather than a single-channel specialist.

You'll think in terms of segments, experiments, and outcomes: building targeted campaigns across the channels we own—push, in-app, and out-of-app (email, SMS)—while connecting those touchpoints with the broader, non-owned channels that shape the member experience.

You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams to turn data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business.
This is a role with department-level impact: you'll own diverse projects, exercise significant independent judgment, and influence how members experience Chime across the full lifecycle.
If you're creative, dedicated, and love working in a fast-paced environment alongside passionate colleagues, we want to meet you.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $139,000 and up to $181,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Own full-funnel lifecycle strategy—from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention—building targeted campaigns that drive growth, revenue, and member LTV.
Define segments and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across owned channels (push, in-app, and out-of-app), connecting them with the broader non-owned channels that shape the end-to-end member experience.
Generate data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize evergreen lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications, working with analytics to measure impact, socialize findings, and develop next steps toward bigger wins.
Develop and steward channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of our communications ecosystem.
Collaborate and build strong relationships with partners across Product, Product Marketing, Engineering, Analytics, Design, User Research, CRM, and more to develop and deliver on shared strategies for large cross-functional initiatives.
To thrive in this role, you have
4–6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing, developing end-to-end campaigns from conceptualization to measurement.
A growth-oriented, business-first mindset—you think about revenue, LTV, and the full funnel, not just individual channels, and you can connect owned channels (push, in-app, out-of-app) with the broader member experience.
A proven track record of building segments and managing successful campaigns across multiple channels (email, push, SMS, in-app messaging).
Strong experimentation chops—comfortable with A/B testing and using results to inform what to scale next.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven marketing and performance analysis.
The ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate with various stakeholders, exercising significant independent judgment.
Experience with key marketing platforms (Braze, Looker; AI tools a plus).
A strong self-starter mindset—adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources.

DeepL is at an inflection point in its growth, and this is an opportunity to directly shape how the world's most accurate AI translation company acquires and converts customers through paid media. As Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and hands-on execution of DeepL's paid social and paid search programmes globally, driving efficient, measurable customer acquisition across SMB and enterprise segments.
This role sits within DeepL's Performance Marketing & Campaigns function and reports to the Director of Performance Marketing & Campaigns. It will work with cross-functional partners across Field, Lifecycle Marketing, SDR, Product Marketing and Marketing Data Science to scale DeepL's paid channels, and partner effectively with stakeholders running ABM programmes.
What You'll Own
Paid Social & Paid Search
Own and scale DeepL's paid social programmes across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X and other emerging channels, tailoring strategy, audiences and creative to each platform's strengths.
Own and scale DeepL's paid search programmes across Google, Bing and other search engines, managing keyword strategy, bidding, ad copy and landing page alignment to maximise efficiency.
Define and manage channel-level budget allocation, shifting spend in response to real-time performance signals to hit CAC, pipeline and ARR targets.
Champion a culture of experimentation: design and run structured A/B tests across creative, audience, bidding strategy and landing experience, translating results into scalable playbooks.
Stay ahead of platform changes, betas and new ad formats across social and search, evaluating and piloting new channels where they offer efficient acquisition.
Campaign Strategy & Execution
Develop and execute global paid social marketing strategies aligned with business objectives across multiple regions and products.
Plan, launch, manage and optimise paid marketing campaigns across the full funnel, including demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), product launches, webinars, events, partner marketing and brand campaigns.
Manage campaign budgets, forecasting, pacing and spend allocation, ensuring efficient investment and continuous optimisation based on performance.
Monitor, analyse and report on campaign performance, pipeline contribution, attribution, ROI and other key marketing KPIs, providing actionable insights and recommendations.
Work cross-functionally with key stakeholders (e.g., Product Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Brand, Creative, Regional Marketing) to align priorities, coordinate campaign execution and support business objectives.
Drive continuous improvement through testing, experimentation, process optimisation, adoption of new advertising capabilities, and AI-driven marketing automation.
ABM Partnership
Bring a strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) principles and mindset to partner effectively with Sales, SDR and the marketing stakeholders who own ABM strategy..
Contribute paid social and paid search expertise to ABM initiatives, executing tailored channel strategies, audiences and creative for prioritised accounts and account tiers as defined by ABM stakeholders.
Feed paid media performance data, account engagement, pipeline influence and conversion, back to ABM stakeholders to inform targeting and strategy decisions.
Measurement & Optimisation
Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to establish rigorous measurement frameworks across conversion rates, pipeline contribution and ARR impact, using these insights to drive continuous optimisation.
Own reporting and forecasting for paid social and paid search, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into spend, efficiency and pipeline contribution.
Use AI-enabled tools to improve audience segmentation, creative testing, bid optimisation and workflow automation across paid channels.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Campaign Managers, Product Marketing, Field Marketing and SDRs to align paid social and paid search activity with integrated campaign programmes and GTM priorities.
Agency/media partner management with clear briefs, KPI accountability, and budget efficiency.
Serve as the paid social and paid search subject matter expert within the Performance Marketing & Campaigns team, sharing best practice and mentoring junior team members.
Represent paid channel performance and investment rationale in relevant leadership and planning forums.

4-6 years of experience in performance marketing, with hands-on ownership of paid social and paid search programmes, ideally within B2B SaaS.
Demonstrated success managing paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit and X (or a similar mix), with a strong understanding of each platform's targeting, bidding and creative requirements.
Strong hands-on experience with paid search platforms, including Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing), across search, display and remarketing.
Very good understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) principles and mindset — comfortable partnering with Sales and marketing stakeholders on account targeting, tiering and personalised campaign strategies, without needing to own or build the ABM programme itself.
Comfort operating in both self-serve and enterprise-assisted sales environments, with an understanding of the B2B buying cycle.

Das erwartet dich aleno ist Liebe. Liebe für Hospitality, für Tech und für das großartige Team, das bei uns beides Tag für Tag verbindet.
Dieses Team wollen wir jetzt um eine Schlüsselrolle erweitern: einen Marketer auf Senior-Level, der das Marketing bei aleno übernimmt und richtig groß macht.
Durch eigene Ideen, das richtige Skillset und vor allem eine stark ausgeprägte Hands-On-Mentalität.
Was wir von der Position erwarten Bei aleno wirst du zum “Unternehmer/ Unternehmerin im Unternehmen”. Du bist unser Marketing – von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung. Konkret heißt das:
Marketing bei aleno in seiner ganzen Breite: Marke stärken und weiterentwickeln (Brand) und Wachstum treiben (Growth). Beides, nicht nur eins davon.
Du legst das Fundament: Zum Start bist du unser Marketing. Die einzige Person im Team. Auf dem, was du aufbaust, wächst die Abteilung weiter, auch personell.
Strategie mitgestalten und selbst umsetzen: Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung legst du fest, wohin es geht. Danach übernimmst du: definieren, umsetzen, messen, nachschärfen, reporten.
Du entwickelst Strukturen weiter: Du setzt Marketing-Automation und den richtigen Tool-Stack auf, pflegst und optimierst sie.
Du arbeitest “Data & KI first”: Deine Entscheidungen basieren auf Daten, nicht nur auf Bauchgefühl. KI ist für dich kein “nice to have”, sondern tägliches Werkzeug, das du schon gekonnt einsetzt. Für Content, Kampagnenoptimierung, Analysen, usw.
Woran du gemessen wirst Wachstum: Deine Maßnahmen sorgen für mehr und bessere Leads, die in direkter Zusammenarbeit mit Sales zu echtem Umsatz werden. (Sales Qualified Leads & Revenue)
Markenbekanntheit: aleno wird im DACH-Raum als Marke sichtbarer und stark in der Hospitality-Szene wahrgenommen.
Wirksames Marketing: Alles, was du tust, zahlt messbar auf unsere gemeinsamen Wachstumsziele ein, nicht auf Vanity Metriken.

About Scopely
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others.

We are looking for someone who quickly grasps changing customer needs, market trends, and the competitive landscape, and is passionate about communicating product value to the marketplace.
In your role as a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will be an expert in buyers, how they buy, their buying criteria and will transfer that knowledge across multiple internal teams.

Success in the role requires strong communication skills, a strategic mindset, a deep understanding of the product marketing discipline, of Jamf products, the market, competition, Apple products and the ability to inspire and effectively collaborate with marketing, product management, product strategy, engineering, sales and other customer-facing teams.
This role is remote in the UK. We are only able to accept applications for those based in the UK or have sponsorship to live and work in the UK.

Awareness and demand generation – collaborate with marketing to influence, drive and support marketing programs that build awareness and drive demand
Assets – Create product and industry-related marketing assets such as white papers, collateral, videos, case studies, presentations, blog/social topics, and more in collaboration with the marketing team
Intelligence - be the expert on the market, our market segments, the buyers – including personas, how they buy and their buying criteria – and our competition. Be seen as the subject matter expert for this intelligence and share it regularly.
Events – support and present at Jamf events, webinars, industry events and internally to educate, build awareness and position Jamf.
Cross-functional collaboration – build strong relationships with product strategy, product management, marketing, sales/account management team, customer support and other internal teams

Executive projects - Manage strategic, highly visible, cross-functional projects that impact Jamf’s business. Examples include launching a new software tool, win/loss program or a new customer advisory board.

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).
We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.
Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.
Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.
Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.
Performance Marketing Specialist

We are seeking a high-caliber Performance Marketing Specialist to take full ownership of our Google Ads ecosystem. This is a critical, high-impact role within our centralized User Acquisition department, specifically designed for a technical expert who excels at scaling Search, Display, and UAC (Universal App Campaigns) at a global level.

You will manage significant monthly budgets and be the primary architect of our growth strategy on Google, turning complex data into high-performing campaigns that drive millions of users to Freecash and our partner projects.

This role demands a "strategic doer"—someone who can build a sophisticated long-term roadmap while remaining deeply hands-on with daily optimizations.

Own the Google Ecosystem: Take end-to-end responsibility for our Google Ads strategy, managing and scaling massive budgets across Search, Display, Discovery, and UAC to meet aggressive ROI and user acquisition targets.
Technical Campaign Excellence: Execute hands-on optimizations, including advanced bidding strategies, deep keyword research, audience segmentation, and structural account refinements to maximize efficiency.
Data-Driven Roadmap: Analyze deep-funnel performance data to identify growth levers, translate findings into actionable strategies, and maintain a rigorous testing roadmap for creatives and landing pages.
Process Engineering: Build and implement scalable marketing processes and reporting frameworks that allow for rapid decision-making and cross-project transparency within the UA department.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with our Creative team to iterate on high-performing assets and with our Data/Product teams to ensure attribution accuracy and alignment with broader business KPIs.

Senior-Level Expertise: 4+ years of experience specifically managing large-scale Google Ads accounts, with a proven track record of scaling budgets while maintaining target ROAS/CPA.
Platform Mastery: In-depth knowledge of Google’s bidding algorithms, tracking requirements (GTM/GA4), and the nuances of mobile app tracking within the Google ecosystem.
Analytical Rigor: Exceptional ability to navigate complex datasets using SQL and Excel to uncover trends that others miss.
Hands-on Execution: A history of being a "doer" who takes pride in the technical setup and daily performance of campaigns, rather than just managing agencies.
Strategic Agility: The ability to pivot between different projects and goals within the UA department, adapting your Google Ads expertise to meet the specific needs of various internal products.
What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟
You are a Proactive Owner: You don’t wait for instructions; you identify inefficiencies in an account and fix them immediately.
You are a Systems Thinker: You love building repeatable processes that make scaling easier and more predictable.
You are Growth-Obsessed: You thrive on the challenge of hitting ambitious targets and are constantly looking for the next 1% improvement that can lead to massive scale.
Why Almedia? 🎁
Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.
Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.
Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.
Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.
We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

SKALAR – Wir bauen die digitale Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft
Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert.
Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich.
Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen.
Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung.
Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen.
Deine Rolle auf Zeit
Als Interim Marketing Manager übernimmst du für 3–6 Monate die zentrale Marketing-Funktion bei Skalar – von Brand über Content bis Performance. Du überbrückst eine Vakanz, hältst das Momentum unseres Go-to-Market und übergibst am Ende ein sauber aufgesetztes, dokumentiertes Setup.
Du arbeitest im engen Trio mit unserem Co-Founder (Growth)unserem Founding Account Executive und Automation Managerin: Der Growth Manager liefert dir Daten zu Funnel, CAC und Channel-Performance, der Founding AE bringt direkt aus den Sales-Calls, was Mandanten bewegt. Du übersetzt beides in Kampagnen, Content und Brand-Arbeit, die qualifizierte Pipeline erzeugen – und schließt den Loop zurück ins Team.
Der Unterschied zu einer klassischen Festanstellung: Du kommst mit wenig Einarbeitung aus, priorisierst hart auf Wirkung im verfügbaren Zeitfenster und hinterlässt ein übergabefähiges System statt loser Enden.

Performance & Demand Gen
Verschiedene Mid- & Top-of-Funnel Ads testen
Landing Pages, Lead-Magnets und Conversion-Strecken iterieren
Paid-Kampagnen (LinkedIn, Google, Meta) gemeinsam mit dem Growth Manager steuern und optimieren
Betrieb & Momentum

**La RSI, Radiotelevisione svizzera di lingua italiana, è un'emittente di servizio pubblico il cui mandato è sancito dalla Costituzione federale, dalla Legge sulla radiotelevisione (LRTV) e dalla Concessione.

Indipendente, è un pilastro del panorama mediatico svizzero, in quanto svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella promozione del dialogo aperto e nella diffusione di informazioni accurate.

Grazie a una vasta gamma di programmi radiofonici, televisivi e digitali, la RSI offre un servizio universale nel campo mediatico, raggiungendo e informando la popolazione in modo capillare.

Questa funzione è essenziale sia per la democrazia, sia per garantire che il pubblico svizzero sia costantemente aggiornato e informato, con una copertura che spazia dalla politica alla cultura, dall'economia all'intrattenimento, dallo sport all'educazione.

La RSI fornisce un quadro accurato della realtà svizzera su scala nazionale, linguistica e regionale, facilitando il dialogo e lo scambio tra le regioni linguistiche della Svizzera.**

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is building new products that can reshape how finance teams operate. These products begin before the market playbook is obvious: the customer problem is still being sharpened, the product is evolving quickly, and the path from early signal to durable growth must be built.
We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager, New Products to lead that work. You will be embedded with Product and Engineering from the earliest stages, using customer and market insight to help choose the audience, shape the product, define the story, and build the commercialization and adoption motion.
This is not a launch-calendar or asset-production role. You will own the full business read for the product: customer problem, ICP, positioning, product readiness, launch, pipeline, activation, adoption, retention, proof, and the next product or GTM intervention.

Shape product strategy early. Bring customer, market, and competitive evidence into product decisions before the roadmap is fixed. Help the team identify the wedge, target segment, table stakes, differentiators, and highest-leverage problems to solve.
Find product-market clarity. Define the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, workflow, alternatives, and reasons customers will switch or expand.
Own the product narrative. Build the canonical positioning, messaging, claims, proof, and competitive story. Translate technical and operational complexity into a clear customer value proposition without flattening how the product works.
Design the zero-to-one GTM. Determine how the product should enter the market, including audience, channel, pricing and packaging inputs, sales motion, self-serve motion, launch sequence, and adoption plan.
Lead launches end to end. Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, Communications, Support, and other partners around one launch strategy, readiness bar, and set of measurable outcomes.
Build commercialization, not just awareness. Create the programs, enablement, proof, and feedback loops that turn interest into qualified pipeline, activation, retained usage, expansion, and revenue.
Work deeply with Product and Engineering. Understand the product's architecture, data, constraints, and trust model well enough to influence tradeoffs and explain it credibly to both technical and business audiences.
Create the customer learning system. Develop direct relationships with buyers and users, run structured discovery, capture objections and product gaps, and turn what you learn into product and GTM decisions.
Own the business scorecard. Define leading and lagging indicators, build a clear operating read, diagnose what is moving or stuck, and recommend the next intervention.
Build proof and competitive intelligence. Develop customer evidence, use cases, benchmarks, and a current view of the market that improve both product decisions and GTM execution.
Use AI as an operating advantage. Apply AI to research, synthesis, analysis, content development, and repeatable workflows—and help the team raise its standard for speed and quality.
Create the new-products playbook. Build a repeatable method for taking an emerging product from customer signal to product-market clarity, launch, commercialization, and scaled growth.
What you'll need
6+ years of experience in B2B software product marketing, product management, growth, strategy, or another product-led GTM function, including significant ownership of a product or business outcome.
Demonstrated zero-to-one experience with a new product, category, platform, or business line—from early customer discovery through launch and adoption.
A record of influencing product strategy using customer, market, competitive, and performance evidence.
Strong customer instincts. You can run discovery, identify the real workflow and buying problem, and separate a loud request from a durable market signal.
Technical and operational fluency. You can learn a complex product, work credibly with Product and Engineering, and explain how it works to different audiences.
Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can produce a sharp product narrative, an executive recommendation, a launch plan, and a sales story that survives contact with customers.
Strong data literacy. You can define and interpret activation, adoption, retention, pipeline, conversion, revenue, and product-usage metrics and turn the findings into a decision.
Proven ability to lead senior partners across Product, Engineering, Sales, Growth, Creative, and Marketing without relying on formal authority.
High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You build the first version, test it with customers, make tradeoffs, and improve it quickly.
Fluency with AI tools as part of your everyday research, analysis, writing, and operating workflows.

Experience in fintech, payments, accounts receivable, accounting, developer tools, data infrastructure, AI, or another technical and workflow-heavy category.
Experience taking a product from incubation through product-market fit and scaled commercialization.
Experience with both product-led and sales-led growth motions.
Experience contributing to pricing and packaging decisions.
Experience as an early or founding PMM, product manager, founder, or operator in a fast-moving product area.

Hay Day is one of Supercell’s most iconic games, delighting tens of millions of players worldwide with its cozy, social farming experience. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and execution - turning every update, feature drop, and seasonal moment into a campaign our players and community can’t stop talking about.
Sitting directly within the Hay Day game team, you will bridge product development, live ops, creative production, and community to turn product updates into major commercial and player-engagement wins.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive End-to-End GTM Strategy: Partner directly with product leads and game designers from early feature concepts to define positioning, f ormulate clear pre-launch hypotheses, and deliver high-impact marketing campaigns for all live updates, seasonal beats, and feature drops.
Lead Creative Campaign Delivery: Direct internal art directors, video producers, and external agencies to produce compelling trailers, visual assets, and marketing collateral that land with Hay Day’s core audience.
Explore Growth Channels with UA: Partner closely with UA and Performance Marketing teams to test and scale performance-driven channels including Connected TV (CTV), influencer integrations, creator platforms, and podcasts and more to expand game reach during major moments.
In-Game & Channel Execution: Operationalize player communications across in-game pop-ups, newsfeed beats, push notifications, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Web Shop / D2C channels.
Amplify via Community & Creators: Collaborate with Community Managers and content creators to design shareable launch beats that drive organic reach and creator content.
Measure & Iterate: Partner with analytics to validate campaign hypotheses, track launch performance, feature adoption, and player sentiment—using post-launch data to continuously sharpen future GTM playbooks.
What You Have
5+ years of Product Marketing experience in mobile gaming or live-service consumer products (casual, simulation, or puzzle experience is a big plus).
Proven GTM execution track record: Demonstrated experience taking live features and product updates from early concept to full public launch.
Sharp creative instincts: Strong aesthetic eye with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback on trailer cuts, visual assets, and player copy.
Performance channel & UA literacy: Solid understanding of performance marketing mechanics and experience evaluating multi-channel campaigns (UA, CTV, creator partnerships, podcasts).
Data & Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: Experience framing clear GTM hypotheses, defining success metrics pre-launch, and using post-campaign analytics to back up strategic decisions.
Cross-functional leadership: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to align developers, artists, and marketers without formal authority.
Collaborative mindset: Naturally builds trust, communicates openly, and thrives in cross-functional teams. Partner with analytics and support the insights team.
Where You'll Be
You are based in or willing to relocate to Helsinki, Finland. Alternatively, located in London with a willingness to travel.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

En tant que B2B Brand Manager, vous transformez nos enjeux business, nos propositions de valeur et les besoins des soignants en positionnements distinctifs, campagnes créatives et plans d’activation à fort impact pour le marché français. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Social Media, Content, Product Marketing, Performance, Brand Design et Communication, ainsi qu’avec nos agences créatives et média.

Stratégie d’activation : concevoir des plans d’activation intégrés en définissant les formats, canaux et contenus les plus pertinents selon les audiences, les objectifs et les étapes du funnel.
Campagnes 360° : imaginer et piloter des campagnes associant communication omnicanale, activations, événements, social media et formats digitaux, de la réflexion stratégique jusqu’au déploiement média.

Mesure de la performance : définir les KPIs, consolider les résultats des campagnes et transformer les enseignements en recommandations concrètes pour les prochaines activations.
Amélioration continue : partager les insights de campagne avec les autres équipes afin d’affiner nos positionnements, nos messages et nos stratégies d’activation.

Creative Strategist, Copywriter, Grafiker und Videografen im eigenen Haus. Kein Warten auf externe Zulieferer, dazu ein AI-Stack für mehr Output.

Core Markets. Our established product lines and the verticals that generate the bulk of Fundraise Up 's ARR, including existing nonprofit segments and cause and cure organizations.

s.h: Deine Spielwiese (Das machst du bei uns)
s.t:

Kanalübergreifendes Denken: Du arbeitest nicht in Silos. Du verstehst, wie die einzelnen Disziplinen (SEA, Paid Social, SEO/GEO, Content, CRO, Web Analytics) ineinandergreifen, und orchestrierst sie zu einer konsistenten Customer Journey – vom ersten Klick bis zur Conversion.
Datenanalyse & Reporting: Du behältst die relevanten KPIs im Blick (ROAS, CPA, Conversion Rate & Co.), erkennst Muster in GA4, Ads-Plattformen und Co. und übersetzt sie in klare, verständliche Handlungsempfehlungen für deine Kunden.
Projektsteuerung: Du hältst in deinen Projekten die Fäden zusammen, koordinierst dich mit Spezialisten aus den einzelnen Kanälen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Strategie auch Umsetzung wird.
KI-Enablement: In unserem eigenen „AI Lab" identifizieren wir neue Use Cases. Du nutzt aktiv generative KI, um deine Workflows zu optimieren, Analysen und Konzepte zu iterieren und schneller zu besseren Entscheidungen zu kommen.
Qualifikation

s.h: Was du in deinem Werkzeugkoffer mitbringst
s.t:
Du hast ca. 1–3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Online Marketing – ob agentur- oder unternehmensseitig, ob generalistisch oder mit einem ersten Schwerpunkt (z. B. SEA, Paid Social, SEO oder Content).
Du hast Freude an der Kundenberatung und daran, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und zu präsentieren.
Du denkst in Kennzahlen: ROAS, CPA, Conversion Rate und Customer Lifetime Value sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Analytisches Denken und Datenliebe stecken in deiner DNA.
Du bringst ein solides Grundverständnis über mehrere Marketingdisziplinen mit und willst verstehen, wie alles zusammenspielt – die Tiefe in einzelnen Kanälen baust du bei uns weiter aus.
Du bist kommunikationsstark, präsentierst gerne und hast Freude daran, Daten in verständliche Geschichten zu übersetzen – auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Du hast keine Angst vor Fehlern, denn du testest gerne hypothesenbasiert und lernst aus jedem Outcome.
Vor allem aber: Du hast Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln und über dich hinauszuwachsen.

Echte Flexibilität: Deine Work-Life-Integration ist uns heilig. Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten.

Kultur & Wohlfühlfaktor: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, Teamevents und eine Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. Und ja, Bürohunde sind bei uns nicht nur erlaubt, sondern absolut erwünscht!

Globale Perspektive: Durch die Zugehörigkeit zur Labelium Group arbeitest du an internationalen Projekten und hast Zugang zum Wissen von über 1.200 hochkarätigen Spezialisten weltweit.
Sicherheit: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sachbezüge, Essenszulagen, Mitarbeiterrabatte und gute Verkehrsanbindungen an unseren Standort in Frankfurt.

We're on a mission
Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.

You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.
The problems you'll own
Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.
Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.
Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.
From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.
The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.
Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.
Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.
This could be for you if
You're an excellent communicator, above all. Writing is the craft at the centre of this job. You make complex things simple without making them shallow, you have taste, and it shows in everything you put out.
You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.
You thrive on the team's success. You get more from a customer win or a teammate's great launch than from your own byline. Small team, shared scoreboard.
You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.
You ship at startup pace. You put things out, learn, and go again, rather than polishing one thing for a month, and you do it without waiting for a brief.
Tooling fluency helps. Comfort with a CMS, email platforms, CRMs and basic design is a real advantage.
What you'll get
You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

As part of the Demand Generation team and reporting to the Director, Regional Marketing, Strategic & Key Accounts, you will play a critical role in driving integrated demand generation, account engagement, and pipeline acceleration across Okta’s highest-value account segments. You will support both the Strategic Accounts Marketing team and the Key Accounts Marketing team by executing a multi-channel integrated framework that moves target accounts through the buyer journey.
This role requires a collaborative, energetic, creative, team-minded, and detail-oriented marketer. You will act as a force multiplier by establishing foundational mechanisms that the team operates upon, looking for continuous opportunities to optimize programs, operations, and reporting, and leveraging AI to streamline and automate workflows to consistently raise the bar for execution.

s.h: THE TILT: WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT
s.t:
We are seeking a proactive marketer who cares personally about team success while bringing energy, discipline, and creativity to daily execution:
Integrated Multi-Channel Framework: Supporting both Strategic and Key Accounts, you will help connect field events, direct mail, digital activations, and peer intelligence initiatives into cohesive, high-impact account journeys.
Foundational Mechanisms & Optimization: Rather than just executing single tactics, you will help build and refine operational mechanisms, playbooks, and reporting structures that optimize how our entire team operates.
AI-Driven Efficiency: You will actively embrace Generative AI and modern automation tools to optimize processes, accelerate content creation, and eliminate administrative friction to continually raise our bar.

Strategic Program Support & Campaign Optimization
Support campaign and program builds: Partner closely with regional marketing managers to assist in the setup, asset coordination, and logistics for field marketing events, executive dinners, VIP receptions, and targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABx) campaigns.
Optimize multi-channel nurtures & customer journeys: Work directly with Marketing Operations to analyze, update, and optimize email nurture sequences through a strategic account lens, unlocking continuous improvements in account engagement and conversion.
Maintain visibility & alignment across team initiatives: Stay deeply plugged into all active regional campaigns across Strategic and Key Accounts to ensure central communication mechanisms, field newsletters, and team playbooks remain accurate and continuously updated.
Serve as key data & operational problem solver: Act as the primary point of contact for troubleshooting data discrepancies, lead routing issues, and campaign tracking errors across Salesforce and Tableau to preserve reporting integrity.
Marketing Operations, Event Logistics & Mechanisms
Manage comprehensive event logistics and vendor relations , encompassing venue sourcing, webinar/platform setup, swag replenishment, and Purchase Order (PO) creation.
Instill and maintain foundational team mechanisms , tracking systems, and operational templates to drive execution rigor, consistency, and business continuity across the Strategic and Key Account segments.
Leverage AI tools and automated workflows to streamline daily operations, optimize reporting, and automate repetitive tasks across assigned programs.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Enablement
Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across Strategic & Key Accounts: Collaborate closely with Regional Marketing Managers (RMMs), Sales, SDRs, Campaigns, Strategic Events, and Product Marketing to align on target account priorities, drive shared revenue outcomes, and systematically capture and share best practices across the broader marketing team.
Lead field sales communication efforts by owning and delivering weekly strategic field marketing newsletters and campaign alerts, positioning marketing campaigns as actionable pipeline levers.
Manage centralized tools and playbooks , such as "Go-To Guides" and Regional Decks, to increase field visibility, standardize marketing plays, and drive field adoption.
Lead Management & Automated Workflows
Oversee campaign enablement and lead management by building localized registration pages (e.g., Splash), crafting urgency-driven invite copy, and establishing white-glove post-event lead routing.
Architect automated follow-up sequences that alert Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to engage prospects, providing them with templated messaging, conversation starters, and account intelligence to accelerate outreach.
Data Analytics, Reporting & Program Optimization
Develop and standardize actionable reporting frameworks for event registration, attendance tracking, and target account intent using Salesforce, 6sense, and marketing analytics platforms.
Empower sales and marketing teams with data-driven insights , leveraging analytics to pivot strategies in real time, evaluate program ROI, and optimize regional targeting strategies.

2+ years of professional B2B tech marketing experience (field marketing, demand generation, or account-based marketing preferred).
Bachelor’s Degree ; Marketing, Communications, or Business preferred.
Experience with marketing and sales technology , including CRM (Salesforce) and Marketing Automation platforms (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua).
Familiarity with ABM platforms and modern tools (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase), event management software (e.g., Splash, Zoom), and project management applications (e.g., Asana).
Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and analyze program performance.
Strong analytical abilities with a passion for working with data, analyzing outcomes, and scoping out key insights to establish continuous optimization.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with a keen attention to detail.
Self-starter mindset who excels at multitasking, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and demonstrates a positive, team-first growth mindset.
